summary: Make the app-launched viewer start in live mode, and make a failed live start visible instead of an empty scene

coordination.notes: node tools/plan-audit.mjs --claims lists no in-progress claim on godot/ at all, so no Codex claim covers world_root.gd right now; the five Codex isometric claims that touch the viewer are all completed. This extends the existing owners rather than adding any: launch_viewer keeps being the one launcher and gains a pure viewer_launch_args seam so the flag can be tested, and world_root._ready keeps being the one place that decides live versus mock. The status label is created by world_root in code rather than added to the scene file, because the .tscn is Codex content and a runtime Label needs no scene change. The module header's 'nothing goes on the command line' rule is narrowed to secrets, keeping the token reasoning intact.
